summary: Legacy renovation completed as Candidate: runtime conditions and attribution revised, historical evidence retained; primary-source reverification and machine recognition remain incomplete.
reviewer: Codex machine-assisted editorial review of retained package material
limitations: Only retained repository excerpts and summaries were reviewed; original source editions and raw historic evaluation outputs were not supplied or newly located.
Source judgments are machine-assisted editorial review, not an independent historical audit.
Bounded recognition was not run: no configured authorized chat-completions endpoint or PERSONA_API_KEY was available. No fresh-context answer/judge calls were dispatched.
Historical scores describe old inputs and protocols; no present recognition or calibrated human-acceptance probability follows.
English voice statistics are inherited translation/OCR-dependent reports and were not recomputed.
Pseudonymous voices remain distinct; the main Postscript text and live conversational evidence remain outside established coverage.
